#Batch effects

##Building a DESeq2 model for SVA Normalization
```{r}
#DESeq2 is used to create a normalized count matrix,that is used for SVA
dds_null_field <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = new_filtered_counts_field,
                              colData = filtered_meta_field,
                              design = ~ 1) # ~1 models the gene expression without any constraints (this is a "blank" model)

#Estimate factor size and normalize the dds model
dds_null_field <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_null_field)

normalized_counts_field <- counts(dds_null_field, normalized = TRUE)
```



##Finding unknown batch effects using sva
```{r}
#Create a model that saves variation from SCTLD_RNA and Location
mod_field <- model.matrix(~ SCTLD_RNA + Location, data = filtered_meta_field) 

#Create a null model
mod0_field <- model.matrix(~ 1, data = filtered_meta_field)

#Remove genes with zero counts
zeroes_removed_counts_field <- normalized_counts_field[
  rowSums(normalized_counts_field) > 0,] #keeps rows in normalized_counts_field that have more than 0 genes

#Estimates the value of the surrogate variables
sva_matrix_field <- svaseq(
  zeroes_removed_counts_field,
  mod = mod_field,
  mod0 = mod0_field,
  B = 200)
```



#Check whether SVs is associated with SCTLD_RNA
```{r}
#Loop surrogate variables
for (i in 1:14) {

  #Create boxplots comparing svs to SCTLD_RNA
  boxplot(sva_matrix_field$sv[,i] ~ filtered_meta_field$SCTLD_RNA, #compares the first surrogate variable to SCTLD_RNA result
          xlab = "SCTLD RNA Status",
          ylab = paste("Surrogate Variable", i),
          main = paste("SV", i, "vs SCTLD RNA Status"))

  #Summarize significance of sv1 explained by/associated with SCTLD_RNA
  print(paste("Results for SV", i)) #prints string with the number of the correlated sv next to it
  print(summary(lm(sva_matrix_field$sv[,i] ~ filtered_meta_field$SCTLD_RNA)))} #lm is a linear regression model to determine significance/association
```

#Identify significant correlations
```{r}
#Create an empty vector to store p-values
sv_pvalues_field <- numeric(14)

#Loop through all 14 surrogate variables
for (i in 1:14) {

  #Run linear regression
  model_field <- lm(sva_matrix_field$sv[,i] ~ filtered_meta_field$SCTLD_RNA) #compares the first surrogate variable to SCTLD_RNA result

  #Extract p-value for SCTLD_RNA
  sv_pvalues_field[i] <- summary(model_field)$coefficients[2, 4]}

names(sv_pvalues_field) <- paste0("SV", 1:14) #name each of the p-values in sv_pvalue_field with the surrogate variable
significant_SVs_field <- names(sv_pvalues_field[sv_pvalues_field < 0.05]) #Identify significant svs
significant_SVs_field
```



#Add SVs to metadata so it can be incorporated into the dds model
```{r}
meta_sva_field <- cbind(
  filtered_meta_field,
  SV = sva_matrix_field$sv)
```



#Create a full DESeq2 model for vst transformation and limma
```{r}
dds_field <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = new_filtered_counts_field,
  colData = meta_sva_field,
  design = ~ SV.1 + SV.3 + SV.4 + SV.5+ SV.6 + SV.7 + SV.8 + SV.9 + SV.10 + SV.11 + SV.12 + SV.13 + SV.14 + Location + SCTLD_RNA)

dds_field <- DESeq(dds_field)

res_field <- results(
  dds_field,
  contrast = c("SCTLD_RNA", "SCTLD_affected", "SCTLD_unaffected"))


#Check how many DEGs remain after removing location and SVs
print(res_field)

sig <- as.data.frame(res_field)
h <- sig %>% filter(padj<0.1)

print(h)
```



##VST Normalization and SVA Removal with Limma
```{r}
#Normalizing with vst
vsd_field <- vst(dds_field, blind = FALSE) #blind = FALSE takes into model consideration

#Extract transformed expression matrix
vst_counts_field <- assay(vsd_field)

#Batch correction using limma
design_field <- model.matrix(
  ~ SCTLD_RNA,
  data = filtered_meta_field)

batch_corrected_field <- removeBatchEffect(
  vst_counts_field,
  batch = filtered_meta_field$Location, #catagorical variable
  covariates = sva_matrix_field$sv[, c(1, 3:14), drop = FALSE], #numarical vector
  design = design_field)
```



##Samples - hierarchical clustering
```{r}
#Create clustering trees before and after batch correction
htree_pre_field  <- hclust(dist(t(vst_counts_field)), method = "average")
htree_post_field <- hclust(dist(t(batch_corrected_field)), method = "average")

#check if sample order and metadata match
stopifnot(all(colnames(vst_counts_field) == colnames(batch_corrected_field)))
stopifnot(colnames(vst_counts_field) == rownames(filtered_meta_field))


#Pre Batch Correction Field
range(htree_pre_field$height)
par(cex = 1.2)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
plot(htree_pre_field,
     main = "Clustering (Pre Batch Correction Field)",
     sub = "", xlab = "",
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.2, cex.main = 1,
     labels = filtered_meta_field$SCTLD_RNA)


#Post Batch Correction Field
range(htree_post_field$height)
par(cex = 1.2)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
plot(htree_post_field,
     main = "Clustering (Post Batch Correction Field)",
     sub = "", xlab = "",
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.2, cex.main = 1,
     labels = filtered_meta_field$SCTLD_RNA)
```




##PCA of the field data
```{r}
#Run PCA on transposed matrix (samples as rows)
pca_field <- prcomp(t(batch_corrected_field), scale. = FALSE)

#Variance explained
percentVar <- round(100 * (pca_field$sdev^2 / sum(pca_field$sdev^2)))[1:2]

#Build PCA dataframe for plotting
pca_df_field <- as.data.frame(pca_field$x)
pca_df_field$sample <- rownames(pca_df_field)
pca_df_field$SCTLD_RNA <- filtered_meta_field$SCTLD_RNA[match(pca_df_field$sample, rownames(filtered_meta_field))] #pca_df_field is a matrix that contains pc1 and pc1 coordinates for each sample. I added a sample column that matches sample IDs to each of the coordinates. I need to add SCTLD_RNA so it will be color coded properly.
pca_df_field$Location <- filtered_meta_field$Location[match(pca_df_field$sample, rownames(filtered_meta_field))]

#Plot
ggplot(pca_df_field, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = SCTLD_RNA)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "SCTLD_unaffected" = "lightgreen",
    "SCTLD_affected" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(
    title = "General PCA of Filtered Field, batch corrected",
    subtitle = "All genes used (VST, blind = FALSE)",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"))
```



```{r}
#VST of vsd_field before batch correction
vst_counts_field <- assay(vsd_field)

#Run PCA on transposed matrix (samples as rows)
pca_field <- prcomp(t(vst_counts_field), scale. = FALSE)

#Variance explained
percentVar <- round(
  100 * (pca_field$sdev^2 / sum(pca_field$sdev^2)))[1:2]

#Build PCA dataframe for plotting
pca_df_field <- as.data.frame(pca_field$x)
pca_df_field$sample <- rownames(pca_df_field)
pca_df_field$SCTLD_RNA <- filtered_meta_field$SCTLD_RNA[match(pca_df_field$sample, rownames(filtered_meta_field))] #pca_df_field is a matrix that contains pc1 and pc1 coordinates for each sample. I added a sample column that matches sample IDs to each of the coordinates. I need to add SCTLD_RNA so it will be color coded properly.
pca_df_field$Location <- filtered_meta_field$Location[match(pca_df_field$sample, rownames(filtered_meta_field))]

#Plot
ggplot(pca_df_field, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = SCTLD_RNA)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "SCTLD_unaffected" = "lightgreen",
    "SCTLD_affected" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Filtered Field Counts (Before Batch Correction)",
    subtitle = "All filtered genes used (VST, blind = FALSE)",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"))
```
